title: ship-flow tests build their git repository once, like finished-work's
notes: Found while fixing d976a3c6 (#404). src/main/ship/ship-flow.test.ts project() starts about 7 git processes per test with no raised timeout; on the Windows runner each spawn costs a few hundred ms, so these can hit vitest's 5 s limit the way finished-work.test.ts did. Do the same as #404: build the repository once in beforeAll and cpSync a copy per test. Only if the windows job shows these near the limit; check its timings first and cancel this card if they are far under.

comments.body: Checked the windows job's timings before writing anything: across the last 10 successful CI runs on main, every ship-flow.test.ts test took 596-1506 ms (slowest 1506 ms, run 45987230844), under a third of vitest's 5 s limit. That is far under, so per the card's own condition no change was made and the card should be cancelled. Reopen it if a windows run shows one of these tests past ~3.5 s.
